business_scope.primary_industry_name: Rope-Access Structural Glass Replacement on Supertall Skyscrapers

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Applicable bilateral investment treaty between the PRC and the foreign investor's home jurisdiction, as verified from MOFCOM's treaty schedule and confirmed by formation counsel before filing
Applicable double taxation avoidance agreement between the PRC and the foreign investor's tax-residence jurisdiction, as verified from the State Taxation Administration treaty schedule
Investment Agreement under the Mainland and Hong Kong Closer Economic Partnership Arrangement (CEPA), if the direct shareholder is a Hong Kong resident enterprise
Investment Agreement under the Mainland and Macao Closer Economic Partnership Arrangement (CEPA), if the direct shareholder is a Macao resident enterprise
Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (RCEP), if the foreign investor is resident in an RCEP member state and the investment falls within the RCEP investment chapter

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (revised 2024, effective January 1, 2025

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), effective 1 July 2024, Articles 4, 23, 26, 27, 29, 33, 35, 47, 54, 58, 66 and 96; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 6, 12 and 29; Administrative Regulation on Market Entity Registration (State Council Order No. 746); Provisions on Foreign Investment Information Reporting (MOFCOM Order No. 62 of 2020).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), acting through the local municipal or district Market Supervision Administration of the registered office; in special economic zones or free trade zones, the integrated FTZ administrative service window will process the SAMR filing and issue the business licence.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Market Entity Registration (Company Registration), accompanied by the Articles of Association and the Foreign Investment Information Report; the SAMR business licence bearing the Unified Social Credit Code constitutes the certificate of incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a general WFOE under the 2023 Company Law; however, Article 47 requires all shareholders to pay the subscribed capital in full within five years from incorporation or within a shorter period specified in the Articles of Association. No blocked escrow account is required by SAMR. Because the WFOE will apply for a construction enterprise qualification for curtain wall or specialized façade work, the capital subscription should be aligned with the applicable MOHURD qualification matrix, which may require a minimum registered capital of RMB 10 million to RMB 20 million and net-asset verification depending on the qualification grade. The capital account must be registered with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange through the receiving bank before foreign currency contributions are remitted.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
ON THIS ___ DAY OF ________, 20___, at a duly convened and quorate meeting of the board of directors of [WFOE LTD] (or acting by unanimous written consent), held in accordance with the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, the Articles of Association and the Foreign Investment Law, the following resolutions were duly adopted.

RESOLVED: (1) Share Capital Subscription. The subscription to the registered capital of the Company in the total amount of RMB ______, divided as set out in the subscription schedule and the shareholder register annexed to this resolution, is hereby ratified and approved. Each shareholder shall pay its subscribed capital in full no later than five years from the date of issuance of the business licence, or earlier if required by the applicable construction enterprise qualification standard. The legal representative is authorized to issue written contribution notices, collect and verify paid-in capital, update the capital contribution register, and execute all foreign exchange registrations for capital contributions.

RESOLVED: (2) Registered Office. The registered office located at [insert full address in China] is hereby adopted as the sole statutory registered office of the Company for all corporate, tax, judicial and administrative purposes. The address has been recorded in the Articles of Association and is evidenced by a valid lease or certificate of ownership. The legal representative and general manager are directed to maintain the address and to file any relocation or change of address with the local Market Supervision Administration within the statutory period.

RESOLVED: (3) Banking Authorization. The opening and maintenance of a RMB basic deposit account, a foreign currency capital contribution account and a general operating account with [insert bank] are hereby authorized. The legal representative, general manager and finance manager, acting under dual-signature authority, are jointly and severally authorized to execute account opening forms, bank mandates, internet banking agreements, remittance instructions, payment instruments, foreign exchange declarations and all related documents. All signatories shall comply with applicable anti-money-laundering and know-your-client policies.

RESOLVED: (4) Statutory Officer Appointments. The following persons are appointed to the statutory offices of the Company with effect from the date of the business licence: [Name] as legal representative and executive director; [Name] as supervisor; and [Name] as general manager. The legal representative shall exercise the powers and duties prescribed by law. The supervisor shall independently monitor the legality of the directors' and senior officers' acts and shall review the statutory books and financial records. The general manager shall have day-to-day operational authority and shall execute contracts within the scope of the Company's business.

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED: (5) The legal representative and the general manager are hereby jointly authorized to prepare, execute and file all documents required for tax registration, social insurance and housing fund registration, foreign investment information reporting, construction enterprise qualification, safety production licence, environmental filing and fire-safety clearance. (6) All prior acts, payments and documents made in connection with the incorporation and pre-opening preparation of the Company are expressly ratified. (7) This resolution shall be effective immediately and shall remain in full force and effect until modified, amended or revoked by a subsequent valid resolution of the shareholders or the board of directors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Foreign Investment Negative-List Pre-Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR National Enterprise Name Reservation System and the local Market Supervision Administration, with consultation against the Ministry of Commerce Foreign Investment Negative List.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit at least three proposed corporate names in Chinese with English transliterations, and a proposed business scope describing specialized construction contracting for building curtain wall engineering, high-altitude rope-access inspection, maintenance and repair of building curtain walls, and replacement of structural glass components. The system will automatically screen for identical or confusingly similar names and will flag any activity appearing in the Foreign Investment Negative List; construction and rope-access façade maintenance are generally permitted foreign-invested activities. Before filing, the foreign investor must have its certificate of incorporation and identity documents notarized, apostilled or consular-legalized as applicable, and must prepare English translations for submission. The name reservation is accessed through the SAMR enterprise registration portal or the integrated local government service portal.
required_dossiers: At least three proposed corporate names in Chinese with English translations
Proposed business scope in Chinese and English
Notarized, apostilled or consular-legalized certificate of incorporation of the foreign investor
Identity documents of the proposed legal representative and directors
Power of attorney appointing local formation counsel
Foreign investor beneficial ownership and source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to identical or misleading characters, immediately file an alternate name from the reserved list. If the negative-list screen flags part of the business scope, narrow the scope to permissible façade repair and maintenance services and submit a revised scope with supporting explanatory letter. If the name suspension is based on formal deficiencies, cure the notarization or translation gaps within the correction period and refile; an adverse negative-list ruling may be subject to administrative reconsideration before SAMR or MOFCOM as applicable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Articles of Association and Foreign Investment Information Reporting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Integrated local Market Supervision Administration service window and the Ministry of Commerce Foreign Investment Comprehensive Information Reporting System.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Promoters must execute the Articles of Association and corporate governance documents, including the director appointments, supervisor appointment, legal representative designation and capital contribution schedule. Submit the Foreign Investment Information Report through the integrated market registration system; the information is transmitted to MOFCOM, SAMR and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. The report must disclose the ultimate beneficial owner, the foreign investor's controlling shareholders, the registered capital, the proposed business scope, the intended operating licence and the contribution period. Because the WFOE will perform construction-like activities, the Articles should reflect that the company will not begin site operations until the construction enterprise qualification and safety production licence are granted. All foreign-language documents must be accompanied by Chinese translations; however, for purposes of this dossier the official regulatory forms are completed in Chinese, while the internal resolutions are retained in English.
required_dossiers: Articles of Association signed by all shareholders
List of directors, supervisor and senior officers with identification documents
Foreign Investment Information Report form completed through the integrated system
Lease agreement or property ownership certificate for the registered office
Capital contribution schedule with payment timeline
Power of attorney and authorized signatory lists
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOFCOM or SAMR issues a query concerning beneficial ownership, submit the corporate pedigree chart and certified ownership statements. If the foreign investment report is suspended for incomplete identity documents, cure the notarization or apostille gap within the notice period. If the system flags the business scope as equivalent to restricted market-entry activity, revise the Articles to delete the restricted wording and maintain a pure construction-service scope, then resubmit through the one-stop registration window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Application and Business Licence Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration responsible for foreign-invested enterprise registration and issuing the business licence.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the unified application for market entity registration through the SAMR enterprise registration service portal or the local integration service hall. The application includes the completed Application for Market Entity Registration, the signed Articles of Association, evidence of registered office, identity documents of the directors, legal representative and supervisor, and the capital contribution schedule. The registration authority will review the application, verify the reserved name and issue the business licence with a Unified Social Credit Code. Under the multi-certificate integration procedure, the registration office electronically notifies the tax authority, social insurance authority, statistics authority, human resources and housing fund authority, so that separate appointment visits are limited. The company may not execute construction contracts or deploy workers until the business licence is obtained and any required sectoral qualifications are secured; the seal-engraving process may begin only after the public security recordation update initiated by the licence issuance.
required_dossiers: Completed Application for Market Entity Registration
Articles of Association in the form required by SAMR
Foreign investor identity and qualification documents
Legal representative, executive director and supervisor appointment documents
Lease agreement or property ownership certificate and landlord consent where applicable
Capital contribution subscription and payment schedule
Foreign Investment Information Report acknowledgment from the integrated system
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a correction notice for missing or inconsistent documents, respond within the statutory correction period, usually 15 working days, and submit the requested item with an explanatory cover letter. If the application is rejected or suspended because the registered address is not confirmable, provide an updated lease, landlord consent or certificate of property ownership. A denial may be challenged through administrative reconsideration at the municipal SAMR or through administrative litigation before a people's court within the statutory time limits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening, Tax, Social Insurance, Housing Fund and Foreign Exchange Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAFE-authorized commercial bank, State Taxation Administration local office, and local social insurance and housing fund centres.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a RMB basic deposit account, a foreign currency capital contribution account and a general operating account with a SAFE-authorized bank. The bank will register the foreign investor's capital account with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange using the business licence, Articles of Association and the foreign investment information report. The foreign investor must then remit the subscribed capital within the contribution schedule; the bank will verify the payment narrative and record the inbound capital in the SAFE system. Tax registration must be completed to obtain a tax identification number, determine whether the company will be VAT general taxpayer or small-scale taxpayer, and establish monthly filing obligations. Social insurance and housing fund registration must cover all future employees, including foreign employees, under local contribution rules. All banking signatories must pass anti-money-laundering due diligence, and the company must adopt a dual-signature mandate for funds above the internal threshold. These registrations are a precondition for hiring staff, issuing payroll, importing materials or making intercompany payments.
required_dossiers: Business licence with Unified Social Credit Code
Company seal, financial seal, invoice seal and legal representative seal after public security recordation
Articles of Association and board resolution on banking authorization
Legal representative identification and passport or residence permit
Tax registration form and information on expected VAT treatment
Social insurance and housing fund registration forms
Beneficial ownership and source-of-funds declaration required by the bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, provide an ownership chain chart, shareholder register and audited financial statements of the ultimate parent. If the SAFE capital account registration is inconsistent with the business licence or Articles, submit a corrected board resolution and amended Articles to the bank; the bank may rescind and refile the foreign exchange registration. Any tax registration error should be cured through the local tax service hall, and any social insurance registration gap should be cured by submitting the employment and payroll records accepted by the social insurance authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Construction Enterprise Qualification and Construction Safety Production Licence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Housing and Urban-Rural Development Department (MOHURD) and local construction administrative authorities.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Construction Enterprise Qualification Certificate under the specialized professional contracting category for building curtain wall engineering, or the appropriate specialized construction category covering structural glass and façade repair, before undertaking any contract work on supertall skyscrapers. The provincial HURD will verify registered capital, net assets, technical management personnel, construction professional certificates, high-altitude rope-access technician credentials, safety officers, equipment and prior project performance. Because this is a newly formed WFOE without project history, the qualification application may initially be granted at the lowest category grade; the company should verify whether the façade repair work must be performed under a general contractor's qualification or as a specialized subcontractor. Concurrently, apply for the Construction Enterprise Safety Production Licence, which requires a safety management system, safety responsibility documents, emergency rescue plan, work-injury insurance coverage, certified safety officers and site safety training records. No field work may commence before both the qualification certificate and safety production licence are issued.
required_dossiers: Construction Enterprise Qualification Application Form
Business licence and tax registration certificates
Capital verification or audited financial statement demonstrating registered capital and net assets
Technical personnel and construction engineer qualification certificates
High-altitude rope-access technician certificates and special operation certificates
Safety management system manuals and safety officer certificates
Social insurance payment certificates for technical staff
Construction Enterprise Safety Production Licence application with emergency plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the qualification application is returned because technical personnel are insufficient, recruit and register certified engineers and specialized workers, then resubmit with updated social insurance evidence. If the safety production licence is suspended due to missing safety officer certificates, appoint the required personnel and apply for immediate re-examination. Denial of a qualification may be challenged by administrative reconsideration before the provincial HURD or by an administrative lawsuit within six months of the written decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: High-Altitude Special Operation Certificates, EIA Registration, Fire Safety and Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Emergency Management Department, Ministry of Ecology and Environment through the local ecology bureau, local fire and rescue authority, and occupational health inspection authorities.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before mobilization, every rope-access technician must hold a valid special operation certificate for high-altitude work, issued or recognized by the Emergency Management Department; employers must also verify IRATA or equivalent rope-access competence and maintain a worker registry. Submit an environmental impact assessment registration form through the national EIA registration system if the glass replacement programme qualifies as a listed construction or maintenance project; for repair and replacement activities on an existing building that do not create new floor area, the competent ecology bureau may treat the project as exempt from formal EIA. The contractor must prepare a construction site fire safety plan, supply temporary fire extinguishers and hydrants, obtain a hot-work permit for any welding or cutting, and store sealants and solvents in a permitted ventilated store. Hazardous waste such as spent sealant tubes, solvent-soaked wipes and broken laminated glass is required to be stored in labelled, covered containers and removed by licensed waste transporters using the national e-manifest.
required_dossiers: High-altitude special operation certificates for all rope-access workers
Rope-access training and competence records
Environmental impact assessment registration form or exemption confirmation
Construction site fire safety plan and hot-work permit applications
Fire fighting equipment inspection and maintenance records
Hazardous waste classification, storage and transfer manifest plan
Emergency rescue plan for work-at-height and structural glass removal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the EIA registration is rejected because the project is classified at a higher tier, commission an EIA Report Form or full EIA Report as directed and resubmit; if the project is exempt, obtain a written exemption note from the ecology bureau. If fire-safety clearance is suspended, cure the equipment and egress deficiencies and request a re-inspection. If a worker is found to lack a valid special operation certificate, suspend that worker from site activity, schedule the certification examination immediately and file a corrective action statement with the emergency management department.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (MOHURD) through the provincial Housing and Urban-Rural Development Department, assisted by the provincial Emergency Management Department for safety production permits and special operation certificates; the local fire and rescue authority is responsible for construction-site fire safety approval.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Construction Enterprise Qualification Certificate (Specialized Professional Contracting - Building Curtain Wall Engineering), Construction Enterprise Safety Production Licence, and Individual Special Operation Certificates for High-Altitude Work.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) through the provincial and municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau using the National Environmental Impact Assessment Registration Management System.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: For structural glass replacement and rope-access façade repair on an existing supertall building, the environmental classification is generally an Environmental Impact Registration Form or an exemption, not a Full EIA Report, because the operation does not create new floor area, generate significant process wastewater, or release large-scale regulated pollutants. If the scope expands to structural alterations, large-scale demolition, or extensive solvent use, the competent ecology bureau may elevate the classification to an EIA Report Form requiring an environmental impact assessment report and written approval.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Construction fugitive dust shall comply with GB/T 16297-1996, with boundary fugitive dust concentration no greater than 1.0 mg/m3. Any construction or washing wastewater must be pretreated and discharged

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; online portal: Electronic Tax Service Platform (E-Tax Bureau) accessible at etax.chinatax.gov.cn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1. The WFOE is incorporated with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and automatically receives the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which is the statutory taxpayer identification number for all PRC tax filings. 2. Within 30 days of obtaining the SAMR business license, the WFOE must complete tax registration and tax identity enrollment at its competent local STA office through the Electronic Tax Service Platform; the system links the USCC to the VAT, Corporate Income Tax, Individual Income Tax, and non-resident withholding registration modules. 3. The WFOE must apply for general VAT taxpayer status if it will issue VAT special invoices or claim export zero-rating and input VAT refunds, and must complete the export tax rebate filing with the tax authority. 4. The non-resident foreign shareholder does not receive a separate Chinese TIN unless it executes a non-resident enterprise tax registration in respect of Chinese-source income; in the ordinary WFOE structure, the WFOE as payer performs non-resident withholding registration and declares those payments through the E-Tax Platform. 5. For cross-border movement of goods, the WFOE must also obtain importer/exporter registration from the General Administration of Customs and enroll with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) for export collection reporting.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The People's Republic of China does not provide check-the-box entity classification or hybrid mismatch elections. A China-incorporated WFOE is automatically a Chinese tax resident enterprise and is taxed at entity level under the Corporate Income Tax Law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: All PRC-established entities, including WFOEs, must complete VAT registration within 30 days of the SAMR business license; there is no turnover threshold for basic tax registration. For VAT status classification, annual taxable sales exceeding RMB 5,000,000 mandate general VAT taxpayer registration; enterprises with annual sales at or below RMB 5,000,000 may remain small-scale taxpayers unless they voluntarily apply for general taxpayer status to claim input VAT credits and export refunds.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China operates a mandatory national electronic invoicing and anti-fraud clearance system. VAT invoices must be issued through STA-approved tax-control digital equipment or through the fully digitalized electronic invoice system on the Electronic Tax Service Platform; invoice data, including the unique invoice code and cryptographic QR stamp, is transmitted in real time to the STA Golden Tax System for validation, matching with customs and foreign exchange data, and anti-fraud analytics. Fully digitalized e-invoices require no physical stamping or paper filing; reconciliation, verification, and export-rebate matching are performed electronically.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods: a VAT general taxpayer may apply zero-rating for goods that are actually declared to China Customs, physically exported from the customs territory, supported by genuine export sale documentation, and for which export proceeds are collected in foreign exchange within the statutory period. Qualifying cross-border supply of services: zero-rating or exemption applies to designated offshore services such as design, research, IT, and consulting supplied by a Chinese VAT taxpayer to a non-resident recipient where the services are performed entirely outside China or consumed wholly offshore and the statutory service-export documentation is filed; however, on-site rope-access facade and structural-glass-replacement services physically performed on real estate located in China are domestic construction services subject to VAT at 9% and are not zero-rated. For services rendered on buildings located outside China, the performance-site test must be satisfied through evidence that personnel, equipment, and work-site operations are wholly outside China.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Goods Customs Declaration Form) accepted and released by China Customs
Ocean or air transport evidence, namely a Bill of Lading or Air Waybill showing actual export movement
Commercial Invoice and Packing List matching the customs declaration
Export sales contract and, where applicable, certificate of origin or export license
VAT special invoice for the exported goods (or export invoice) reflecting the zero-rated supply
Bank-issued Export Proceeds Collection Confirmation / Inward Remittance Certificate evidencing foreign exchange repatriation within the statutory period
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Claiming 0% VAT on exports without satisfying the Customs, logistics, contract, and foreign-exchange repatriation requirements is treated as an unauthorised export-tax-refund claim. The STA may retrospectively open a three-year or longer audit window in civil tax-evasion cases and perform bulk data triangulation between Customs export releases, logistics tracking, bank FX receipts, and invoice clearance. If zero-rating is denied, the supply is recharacterized as a domestic taxable supply: the exporter must pay output VAT at the applicable rate (9% for construction services or 13% for goods), repay any input VAT refund or export rebate previously received, and pay a late-payment surcharge at 0.05% per day. Administrative penalties range from 50% to 500% of the tax evaded; intentionally fraudulent export-refund claims may additionally constitute criminal liability under Article 204 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, with penalties including imprisonment up to life imprisonment and confiscation of property.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China maintains current-account convertibility and closed, approval-based capital-account convertibility. For the registered WFOE, foreign exchange receipts under genuine trade and service contracts may be settled at a SAFE-designated domestic bank as long as supporting documentation is presented. Cross-border capital injection for registered capital is credible only after SAFE's outward-remittance registration and bank-level verification; capital cannot be casually re-deployed to equity investments or real estate outside the scope. Current-account outflows, including service fees and import payments, must be underpinned by contracts, invoices, tax declarations, and valid business licences; profit remittance is permitted only after annual audit, tax clearance, and legal-reserve accrual in compliance with the WFOE Law. Surplus funds under capital account face tight restrictions, and any change in currency denomination or settlement basis may trigger fresh SAFE filings. Long-term convertibility hinges on the project's economic authenticity, the bank's compliance rating, and the absence of adverse media; hence the banking relationship must be structured with full evidentiary transparency.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE's export collection verification rules for goods trade, export proceeds must be repatriated to China through a designated bank within 180 days of the export clearance date; the mandatory surrender ratio has been abolished since 2012, so the statutory conversion ratio is zero percent. Receipts must be recorded in the SAFE monitoring system and either retained in an eligible foreign-exchange account or settled into RMB at the bank's spot rate against a complete customs and commercial document set. For this WFOE's cross-border construction services, high-altitude facade proceeds are current-account service receipts and must be declared under service trade with signed statements of work, invoices, and bank records; no goods-customs timeline applies unless construction materials are physically exported.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Capital Account and RMB Settlement Capital Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational Settlement Account (RMB and Foreign Exchange)
Cross-Border Business Account with Trade Settlement and Escrow Sub-Ledger
Global Banking Settlement Account with FX Hedging Facilities

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMIs such as Revolut, Wise, or Airwallex do not hold a PBOC banking licence or a SAFE cross-border FX settlement licence and are therefore legally barred from servicing a mainland WFOE as a local clearing or account-holding institution. An EMI may only appear in the payment stack as an ancillary front-end collection tool if its licensed Chinese partner bank performs the underlying SAFE registration, FX settlement, and capital verification; standalone onboarding viability for this WFOE is effectively nil.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A face-to-face interview at the domestic licensed bank's Mainland China branch is mandatory for the legal representative and the actual senior responsible officer before any capital account or basic settlement account can be activated. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted as a complete substitute; at best, a notarized power of attorney in Chinese and English, combined with a recorded video interview and a China-based authorized signatory, can be used after the physical appearance of the legal representative has been completed. The bank's PBOC-mandated customer due diligence also requires production of original entity chops, unified social credit code certificate, statutory licences, and board resolutions in the bank's approved format.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore shareholder chain ending in unclear individual natural-person ownership with shell holding vehicles.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled ownership chain up to each ultimate beneficial owner, certified board resolution authorizing the WFOE formation, two years of audited parent financial statements, passport copies of UBOs with bank-fronted verification, and a signed beneficial ownership declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Statutory construction qualification for high-altitude rope-access facade work is missing, expired, or inconsistent with the bank's industry risk classification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: MOHURD Construction Enterprise Qualification Certificate for specialist works, valid Safety Production License, Occupational Health and Safety certification, high-altitude worker insurance binder, signed project work orders, and the safety supervision filing issued by the municipal housing construction authority.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border capital injection is planned for working capital broader than the registered scope or without a traceable business purpose.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Approved feasibility study and one-year cash-flow budget, signed facade subcontract with the skyscraper owner, procurement contracts for structural glass and anchorage equipment, supplier pro-forma invoices, a completed SAFE capital verification report, and a no-adverse-media background letter for the ultimate funder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Future outbound disbursements include payments to an overseas related party in a jurisdiction different from the contracted subcontractor.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amendments or annexes to the contract explicitly naming the payee bank account, validated commercial invoices with Incoterms, customs import declarations where goods cross the border, a Chinese tax clearance certificate for the WFOE, CRS/FATCA self-certifications, and a transfer-pricing summary prepared by an independent tax adviser.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The parent must route a SWIFT MT103 wire to the WFOE's SAFE-registered Foreign Exchange Capital Account at the nominated Tier-1 bank, using the SAFE purpose code for foreign direct investment capital injection and quoting the WFOE's unified social credit code in the remittance field. The receiving bank, after checking the SAFE registration record, will acknowledge the capital inflow and permit capital settlement into RMB; this triggers a capital verification report by a licensed Chinese CPA, related industrial and commercial filings, and tax registration. No part of the capital can be redirected to securities, entrusted loans, or real estate beyond the approved business scope.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Progress payments for labour and small material purchases are cleared through SWIFT MT103 wires executed by the domestic bank's international clearing channel; medium-value facade procurement is settled by Sight Commercial Letters of Credit opened at the WFOE's nominated bank; documentary collections are used for invoice-backed disbursements when the counterparty accepts deferred payment. RMB-denominated cross-border settlements must be cleared through CIPS (Cross-Border Interbank Payment System) while USD and EUR flows use correspondent bank rails; every outward payment must be matched to an inward guarantee or underlying project invoice and screened by the bank's sanctions and anti-money-laundering filter.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: RMB/USD spot and forward contracts with genuine trade-background support and SAFE registration at a licensed onshore bank.
Foreign exchange swaps and currency swaps matching the tenor of the WFOE's future facade revenue or supplier payments, subject to CFETS/Shanghai Clearing House rules.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permitted onshore; offshore NDF access cannot be booked in the China banking book.
Long-dated cross-currency swaps for contracted capital expenditure are permissible only with SAFE special approval and a maturity profile aligned to the underlying cash flows.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inclusion in the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations; after three consecutive years of non-filing, administrative strike-off (revocation of business license) and a fine of up to RMB 20,000 (approx. USD 2,800) may be imposed.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Settlement (Annual CIT Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to May 31 of the following year for calendar-year taxpayers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on the unpaid tax, penalties from 50% to 5 times the underpaid tax, enforced collection by tax authority, and potential criminal liability for evasion.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SAMR and People's Bank of China (PBC) beneficial-owner registration system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 each year; changes in ownership must be reported within 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties up to RMB 50,000 (approx. USD 7,000) for the entity and RMB 20,000 (approx. USD 2,800) for responsible persons, plus adverse credit record.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All WFOEs must undergo an annual statutory audit under Article 164 of the Company Law and the Foreign Investment Law; no quantitative exemption exists based on balance sheet, turnover, or headcount. The audit must be conducted by a certified CPA firm in China.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: China Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (China GAAP, CAS); small enterprises may use Small Enterprise Accounting Standards; audit performed under Chinese Standards on Auditing (CSA).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Beneficial owners must be disclosed to SAMR upon incorporation and updated in each annual report submitted by June 30. Any shareholding transfer or change in beneficial ownership exceeding 25% must be filed with SAMR within 30 days of the change, in accordance with the Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information (effective November 1, 2024).

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic free-zone tax holiday for a mainland WFOE. Standard rate is 25%; small low-profit enterprises may enjoy an effective 5% rate on taxable income up to RMB 3,000,000; High/New-Technology Enterprises can access a 15% rate; qualifying R&D expenditures are entitled to a 100% super deduction (175%-type uplift in effect via full extra deduction); certain qualified software enterprises may access a 10% rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Corporate Income Tax Annual Return Form A (e-file code A100000) and its supporting schedules; filed electronically through the State Taxation Administration Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax) portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return and self-assessment must be filed within five months after the close of the calendar tax year, i.e. on or before May 31 of the following year. Quarterly corporate income tax prepayments are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross operating revenue from rope-access structural glass replacement and facade maintenance services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all China-source service revenue on an accrual basis. Cross-border subcontract service fees paid to overseas vendors must be supported by contracts and may attract withholding tax when paid to non-residents; no deduction for such withholding unless it is tax borne by the WFOE under the contract and recorded as income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating costs, including direct materials, labor, subcontractor costs, equipment rental and site-specific expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party subcontractor costs must satisfy the arm's-length standard. Any payment to a foreign related party without adequate contemporaneous documentation will be adjusted under Article 41 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law, creating underpaid tax, interest and penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business taxes and surcharges, such as urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges and stamp duty.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only taxes actually paid and properly accumulated in the books are deductible. Penalties and late surcharges from tax reassessments are not deductible for corporate income tax purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling expenses, including bid and tender costs, marketing, branding and business development expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Marketing payments to a foreign parent or sales agent must be supported by actual services rendered, pricing benchmarks and transfer pricing documentation. A management fee merely allocated without service evidence is non-deductible and may be treated as a deemed dividend subject to 10% withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Administrative expenses, including wages, rent, office expenses, insurance and professional fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses attributable to the foreign parent's stewardship or shareholder activity are not deductible unless the WFOE proves the service was rendered to the WFOE and benefited its trade. Underpayment of corporate income tax via such deductions exposes the payer to 0.05% daily late surcharge and a fine up to five times the underpaid tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial expenses, principally interest on intercompany loans, bank charges and exchange losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to non-resident shareholders is subject to statutory 10% withholding tax, and thin-capitalization rules restrict deductible interest where the debt-to-equity ratio exceeds 2:1 for a general enterprise. Excessive interest is recharacterized as a distribution and is again subject to withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Asset impairment losses and bad debt allowances.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Impairment allowances are generally non-deductible unless they meet strict Chinese tax-law conditions. Cross-border receivables from related foreign entities require credible collection effort, contemporaneous evidence and bad-debt substantiation; otherwise the deduction is rejected.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total accounting profit before tax adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the bridge figure from statutory financial statements. Non-resident withholding obligations are not recorded as a tax expense here; dividends declared to foreign shareholders are not an expense item.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit adjustments, including transfer pricing adjustments, disallowed expenses, R&D super deduction and tax-exempt income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Transfer pricing corrections must be brought into the return as upward adjustments; omission of the related-party transaction disclosure schedule can trigger a special tax investigation. Permanent establishment and treaty-protection positions must be documented before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after non-taxable income, treasury bond interest exemptions, loss carryforward and all legal adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carryforward expiry applies at five years for ordinary enterprises. A WFOE with persistent losses despite high gross revenue is a red flag for tax authorities and may be subject to deemed income adjustment under economic-substance audit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable at the applicable rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Preferential rates must be evidenced by valid qualification certificates. If the WFOE has passed dividends to a non-resident parent, the dividends themselves are not included in this box; the withholding obligation arises separately on the profit distribution and must be declared via the withholding return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance of tax due after quarterly prepayments and foreign tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits are available only where the WFOE has foreign-source income, supported by foreign tax payment vouchers. Underpayment triggers immediate interest accumulation and credit blacklisting if not settled by the May 31 deadline.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing is penalized under Article 62 of the Tax Collection Administration Law with a fine of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000; late tax payment attracts a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax. False or fraudulent filing is penalized under Article 63 with a fine of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax. Criminal tax evasion under Article 201 of the Criminal Law arises where the evaded tax exceeds RMB 50,000 and represents more than 10% of taxable tax due; directors and directly responsible officers face imprisonment of up to seven years, fines, forfeiture of assets and exit-restriction measures.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividends distributed by a Chinese resident enterprise to a non-resident enterprise; treaty reductions may apply, e.g. 5% under the Mainland-Hong Kong Arrangement for a beneficial owner holding at least 25% of the WFOE's equity.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The WFOE, as withholding agent, must withhold 10% at the time of dividend distribution unless treaty relief is approved. To claim DTA relief, the foreign shareholder must file a Non-Resident Treaty Benefit Application with the competent Chinese tax authority and provide: (1) a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the residence-state tax authority and duly legalized/apostilled; (2) a beneficial ownership declaration; (3) shareholding and corporate structure documentation; and (4) evidence the shareholder has functional substance, not a conduit. Treaty relief can be granted before payment or by refund within three years after over-withholding. The withholding agent remains liable for tax if the dividend is paid without an approved treaty-reduced rate and the beneficial owner fails the assessment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on cross-border interest and royalties is 10% for non-resident enterprises. Under the Mainland-Hong Kong Arrangement, qualifying beneficial owners may reduce interest to 7% and royalties to 5%. Royalties for the use of industrial, commercial or scientific equipment and patents/software may apply, but substance and source testing is strict. Interest, royalties and service fees must be arm's length; excessive amounts are disallowed as deductions and re-taxed as distributions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: RMB 200,000,000 for mandatory Local File (annual related-party tangible goods transactions); RMB 100,000,000 for financial assets; RMB 50,000,000 for intangible assets and financial loans; Master File is applicable when total annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 1,000,000,000; Country-by-Country notification is triggered where the ultimate parent's consolidated revenue is above RMB 5,500,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not apply a separate Economic Substance Regulations framework, but the General Anti-Avoidance Rule under Article 47 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law and the substance-over-form principle recharacterize arrangements lacking commercial purpose. A WFOE performing rope-access facade services must demonstrate core income-generating activities in China: contracts, skilled employees, site supervision, decision-making, equipment, bank accounts and actual billing. A shell or conduit arrangement created solely to obtain treaty benefits or strip profits offshore will be disregarded and reassessed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE intentionally underreports high-altitude facade service revenue, inflates construction costs, uses unrelated fake invoices to create artificial expenses, or keeps two sets of accounting records to evade enterprise income tax and VAT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 63 of the Tax Collection Administration Law imposes recovery of additional tax, a financial penalty of 50% to 500% of the tax underpaid, plus 0.05% daily late-payment interest. Article 201 of the Criminal Law imposes criminal fines and imprisonment of up to seven years where the evaded amount is significant and exceeds 10% of payable tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced when the WFOE is used as an instrument of fraud. Directors and directly responsible persons are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of tax underpaid, their personal assets may be attached, they may be placed on the tax blacklist and exit-banned, and they risk criminal prosecution with up to seven years' imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Abuse and Thin Capitalization
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE pays excessive management fees, royalties or interest to its foreign parent, deliberately misprices cross-border rope-access subcontracts, or maintains excessive shareholder debt without arm's-length intent so as to strip Chinese taxable profits abroad.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Articles 41-46 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law and the special tax adjustment rules require transfer pricing adjustment with interest computed on the adjusted tax. Excess interest under the 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio for general enterprises is non-deductible and recharacterized as a deemed dividend subject to 10% withholding tax. Late-payment surcharges and fines up to five times the underpaid tax apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve or implement non-arm's-length related-party transactions can be personally assessed where the corporate form is used to evade tax. They face civil recovery, travel bans, blacklisting, and if they conceal assets or use the company to evade taxation, criminal liability under Articles 201 and 203 of the Criminal Law with imprisonment up to seven years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Treaty Shopping Abusive Structure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE is a transparent letterbox entity with no real office, no substantive operational staff, and no real decision-making in China; a foreign intermediary is inserted solely to invoke a tax treaty and channel facade-service profits out of China without economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 47 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law and the General Anti-Avoidance Rule allow the tax authority to disregard the shell structure, deny treaty benefits, recharacterize the income as Chinese-source, and impose full 10% (or higher) withholding tax, with late interest and penalties under Articles 48 and 49 of the Tax Collection Administration Law.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the WFOE is merely a sham and the directors misuse limited liability to deceive tax authorities, the personal civil liability of directors attaches to restored taxes, interest and fines. Directors face exit bans, seizure of personal assets, blacklisting, and criminal prosecution for fraudulent tax avoidance with imprisonment potential under Article 201 of the Criminal Law.
